title: Hp security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-165.091418: TT-CSIRT Advisory – HP Security Updates
leadParagraph: HP has released a security update stating that it has discovered a vulnerability in some versions of its inkjet printers where a maliciously crafted file sent to an affected device can cause a stack or static buffer overflow which could allow remote code execution.
contentHtml:
HP has released a security update stating that it has discovered a vulnerability in some versions of its inkjet printers where a maliciously crafted file sent to an affected device can cause a stack or static buffer overflow which could allow remote code execution.

Further information on this vulnerability and which inkjet printer versions it affects can be found on the HP Website at https://support.hp.com/us-en/document/c06097712
